resources.string: Saved on this phone only. Not written into the app code.
Use a remote URL instead of the bundled dashboard
Example: On — load the Remote URL. Off — use the dashboard copied into the app.
Remote URL needs to start with https:// or http://
Example: On — open the dashboard after restart. If it does not, allow Display over other apps, or set Home Dashboard as the Home app.

Settings → Display → Screen saver
Pick Home Dashboard
When to start: While charging
Start now previews the same dashboard.
Status URL and bearer token are in the dashboard Help button (top right).
To open after boot, allow Display over other apps for Home Dashboard.
